_howItWorks: parentheses "alternative": the text inside the group is a different name for the words in 'replaces', which sit directly before the group in the source line. Items inside the group are split on commas and each one replaces those words. 'Secretary of War (Defense)' with replaces 'War' is stored as 'secretary of war' and 'secretary of defense'.

_items: Optional 'items': use these names instead of splitting the group on commas. Used where the owner accepts only some of the listed names ('boarding' alone is NOT accepted, only 'quartering').  All names of one marker are ONE answer: the matcher counts them once (answerGroups in the data files).
_numberAlone: 'numberAlone' lists source lines where the bare number is an accepted answer, because the number answers the question by itself. Rule: accept when the number alone answers the question (What amendment, How old, When year). Do not accept for 'Why' questions, or when the number is only part of an explanation ('13 original colonies'), or when unsure.
